text_en: Dragon Ball: Sparking! Zero is a 2024 fighting game developed by Spike Chunsoft and published by Bandai Namco Entertainment, marking a significant revival of the *Budokai Tenkaichi* series. As the fourth main installment following *Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3* (2007), it introduces a fresh identity under the *Sparking!* title, which had previously been exclusive to Japan. The game seamlessly blends the iconic 3D combat mechanics of its predecessors with modern visual upgrades, delivering a dynamic experience that stays true to Akira Toriyama’s legendary universe. Players can unleash devastating Ki blasts, master fluid movement, and engage in high-octane battles across iconic stages from the *Dragon Ball* saga, including the Hyperbolic Time Chamber and the World Martial Arts Tournament.
